description: Fetch the actual simplified GeoJSON FeatureCollection geometry for a country/ADM level from geoBoundaries. WARNING: geometry payloads are large (a simplified national ADM1 set can be several MB); this only returns the simplified geometry and refuses payloads over ~4 MB — for those use get_boundaries and download the URL directly. Prefer get_boundaries unless you explicitly need the coordinates. Not valid for adm="ALL".

adm.description: Admin level (single level only; "ALL" is not supported here).

product.description: Boundary product. gbOpen (default, CC-BY) | gbHumanitarian | gbAuthoritative.

name: get_geometry
title: Get Geometry
